name: Atmospheric color grading and mathematical Atkinson and Riemersma dithering
description: Verify drawing a solid colored ball and sprite, applying atmospheric mood color grades (Sunset, Moonlight, Neon), and executing mathematical error-diffusion dithering algorithms.

planSteps.description: Click the Ellipse tool button in the left toolbar (or press O)
Click on the center drawing canvas to stamp an ellipse
Click the Flood Fill tool button in the left toolbar (or press G)
Click on the canvas to fill the shape with color
Verify artwork is clearly visible on the canvas
Click the 'PixiBud AI' tab button in the right inspector panel
Verify the 'COLOR SCIENCE & MORPHING' section is visible
Click 'Sunset', review the before-and-after preview, then click 'Apply to Layer'
Verify the Sunset atmosphere grade is applied
Click 'Atkinson Dither', review the before-and-after preview, then click 'Apply to Layer'
Verify dithering is applied across the artwork
Click 'Smooth Dither', review the before-and-after preview, then click 'Apply to Layer'
Verify dithering updates across the layer
